properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.audiences
properties.description: Identifies the recipients that the JWT is intended for.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authorities-claim-delimiter
properties.description: Regex to use for splitting the value of the authorities claim into authorities.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authorities-claim-expressions
properties.description: List of expressions to use to extract authorities from a JWT. Mutually exclusive with 'spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authorities-claim-name' and 'spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authorities-claim-delimiter'.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authorities-claim-name
properties.description: Name of token claim to use for mapping authorities from JWT.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.authority-prefix
properties.description: Prefix to use for authorities mapped from JWT.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri
properties.description: URI that can either be an OpenID Connect discovery endpoint or an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata endpoint defined by RFC 8414.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: JSON Web Key URI to use to verify the JWT token.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jws-algorithms
properties.description: JSON Web Algorithms used for verifying the digital signatures.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.public-key-location
properties.description: Location of the file containing the public key used to verify a JWT.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.opaquetoken.client-id
properties.description: Client id used to authenticate with the token introspection endpoint.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.opaquetoken.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret used to authenticate with the token introspection endpoint.

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.opaquetoken.introspection-uri
properties.description: OAuth 2.0 endpoint through which token introspection is accomplished.
